record_title: Entropy-gauge and corner-minimization obstructions in entropy-based local characteristic decomposition
provenance: Exact convex-analysis and entropy-pair analysis of the interface-state selector introduced in arXiv:2609.19838v1.
limitations: This is a source-specific correction and invariance result, not an instability or convergence-failure theorem. The published four-candidate ELCD remains well-defined after fixing an entropy normalization, and the gauge-invariant alternative score has not been benchmarked.
